xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2988: Lost review.status_changed event strands a merge-ready issue: invisible on Awaiting Merge, all actions gated, no re-sync path

plan.title: Lost review.status_changed event strands a merge-ready issue: invisible on Awaiting Merge, all actions gated, no re-sync path
plan.author: agent:k3

narratives.Problem: The status_changed branch of the dashboard pipeline handler (src/dashboard/server/main.ts:248-267) enriches via async tmux before es.append, with no timeout and no retry; a wedged tmux call or a server restart loses the review.status_changed domain event silently. The read model (reviewStatusByIssueId) advances only via events, so one lost event permanently strands a merge-ready issue off Awaiting Merge with all actions gated, while read-door surfaces see the truth. Verified incident: PAN-806 on 2026-07-21 (67-minute drift, 327 other events appended fine).
narratives.Proposal: Four changes (full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-2988.md): (1) a shared emit helper src/dashboard/server/review-status-emit.ts appends the UNENRICHED status synchronously at all three emit sites, then applies a bounded (5s), stale-guarded, sugar-only enrichment patch; (2) enrichReviewStatusPromise wraps listSessionNames in Effect.timeout('5 seconds'); (3) the read door getReviewStatusSync emits status_changed when its journal-newer reconcile changes the effective status, and a new 60s dashboard-side sweep service diffs canonical statuses against the latest emitted event per issue (new EventStore.queryLatestPerIssue) and re-emits on drift; (4) a read-only POST /api/review/:issueId/resync endpoint + 'pan review resync <id>' verb + never-gated RECOVER-menu action 'Re-sync pipeline state' give the operator an escape hatch. Ratchet: review-status.ts and cli/index.ts are at their line baseline, so items 3 and 6 are extraction-shaped and lower scripts/file-size-baseline.txt in-commit.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing the deploy-patrol per-issue record lock hold (separate issue, incident contributing factor)
- Replacing the read model's bootstrap+events architecture with polling
- Changing the review.status_changed reducer semantics (wholesale replace stays)
- Backfilling historically lost events (the sweep heals live drift going forward)
- Any mutation-capable force-status operator action (resync is strictly read + re-emit)
- Reconciliation for event types other than review.status_changed

autoDecisions.summary: Implement all three issue fix directions plus both operator comment additions (timeout after reorder; periodic sweep)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body states all three are needed and the operator's verified comment names the two additions explicitly; no documented options remained to choose among.

autoDecisions.summary: Emit helper placed at src/dashboard/server/review-status-emit.ts with a structural append callback
autoDecisions.rationale: Both server call sites (main.ts, deacon-main.ts) can share it without new lib import cycles; the append injection covers EventStore.append and the deacon eventClient.

autoDecisions.summary: Enrichment patch guarded by updatedAt stale-check and no-sugar skip
autoDecisions.rationale: Without the guard a slow patch overwrites a newer transition in the wholesale-replace reducer; without the skip every transition emits two events of noise.
list-sessions is a local tmux call that returns in milliseconds when healthy; 5s is generous yet bounds the leak the operator flagged.

autoDecisions.summary: Reconcile sweep is dashboard-side (60s, primary-process gated), not a deacon patrol
autoDecisions.rationale: The drift detector needs EventStore query access; the deacon child process has an append-only event client and cannot query the parent's store.

autoDecisions.summary: Recovery endpoint is read-only POST /api/review/:issueId/resync with verb 'pan review resync <id>'
autoDecisions.rationale: The incident recovery mutated state via POST /api/review/:id/status; a read + re-emit endpoint removes the mutation hazard and needs no body validation.

autoDecisions.summary: Ratchet compliance via extraction (review-status-reconcile.ts, review-subcommands.ts) with baseline reconciliation in the same commits
autoDecisions.rationale: src/lib/review-status.ts (1159) and src/cli/index.ts (1412) sit exactly at baseline; extraction is the smallest change that adds behavior while netting the god files down.

items.title: Append unenriched review status synchronously via a shared emit helper at all three emit sites

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/server/review-status-emit.ts exporting emitReviewStatusChanged(append, issueId, status) per the PRD snippet: (1) append the unenriched status synchronously; (2) async enrichment patch bounded by Effect.timeout('5 seconds') with catchAll-to-null, skipped on timeout/failure (warn log), skipped when no sugar fields were produced, and skipped when getReviewStatusSync shows a different updatedAt (stale guard against the wholesale-replace reducer). Rewire the three call sites to it: main.ts:248-267 status_changed branch, main.ts:478-494 setMergeReadyNotifier, deacon-main.ts:97-108 setMergeReadyNotifier (drop its now-unused enrichReviewStatus import). Keep the existing try/catch error logging around the sync append in main.ts. Tests with vi.useFakeTimers cover: sync append before enrichment resolves; hung enrichment past 5s logs a warning and yields exactly one event; sugar + unchanged updatedAt yields a second enriched event; moved updatedAt yields no second event; no-sugar yields no second event.

Given enrichment that returns sugar fields and an unchanged canonical updatedAt, when the patch runs, then it appends a second review.status_changed event carrying the enriched status
Given a newer canonical updatedAt or enrichment with no sugar fields, when the patch decision runs, then it appends no second event
Given the rewired call sites, when grep runs over main.ts and deacon-main.ts, then no remaining call site awaits enrichReviewStatus before appending review.status_changed

New test file tests/unit/lib/review-status-enrichment.test.ts mocks ./tmux.js listSessionNames to never resolve and asserts, under vi.useFakeTimers, that enrichReviewStatusPromise resolves with the unenriched status (no sugar fields) after advancing 5s.

narrative.Action: Extend the EventStore door (src/dashboard/server/event-store.ts) with queryLatestPerIssue(type): StoredEvent[] using the grouped MAX(sequence) SQL from PRD item 4 (verify column names against the insertStmt at event-store.ts:243-250 first; fallback to queryByType + JS grouping if json_extract does not apply, noting it in the commit message). Create src/dashboard/server/services/review-status-reconcile-service.ts following the merge-blocker-reconcile-service.ts:107-127 start/stop/setInterval+unref pattern with POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000: each tick enumerates loadReviewStatuses() (src/lib/review-status.ts:195), reads canonical getReviewStatusSync(issueId), skips falsy or mergeStatus === 'merged', and when no review.status_changed event exists for the issue or the last event's status.updatedAt is older than the canonical updatedAt, logs the healing line from the PRD and re-emits via emitReviewStatusChanged (item durable-sync-emit) bound to getEventStore().append. Per-tick errors are swallowed. Start it in main.ts right after startMergeBlockerReconcileService() (:213) with a boolean primary-process gate and started/skipped logging like startUatTrainReconciler (main.ts:510-514). Tests use vi.useFakeTimers: drift → exactly one re-emit per tick; no drift → zero appends across ticks; throwing tick keeps the interval alive; event-store test covers queryLatestPerIssue picking the latest event per issue.

Add read-only POST /api/review/:issueId/resync that re-emits the canonical review status

expected_outputs: route tests pass: 200 + one status_changed notify for existing status, 404 for missing, write door never called

narrative.Action: Add the route beside the reset route in src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/review-control.ts (:322-398), mirroring its auth/CSRF guards exactly. Handler: getReviewStatusSync(issueId) → 404 { ok: false, error } when falsy; otherwise notifyPipelineSync({ type: 'status_changed', issueId, status }) and return { ok: true, status }. The route never calls setReviewStatus and accepts no status body; its comment documents it as the read-only operator escape hatch for PAN-2988 lost events. Route test mirrors tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/reset-review-route.test.ts.
